strategy.overview: Complete C-I-T-Y and S-L-I-C-K-E-R, or collect all four $ rollovers, to qualify Shoot-Out in Uptown. Shoot the qualified top saucer to capture a ball and bring the second ball into play. During the timed Shoot-Out, hit Uptown targets 1, 2, and 3 in order; completing the sequence scores the lit $ value.
strategy.simpleOverview: Complete C-I-T-Y and S-L-I-C-K-E-R, or all four $ rollovers, then shoot the qualified top saucer. With two balls in play, hit Uptown targets 1, 2, and 3 in order before the Shoot-Out timer expires to score the lit $ value.
strategy.summary: Complete C-I-T-Y and S-L-I-C-K-E-R or all four $ rollovers, shoot the qualified top saucer, then hit Uptown targets 1, 2, and 3 in order during the timed two-ball Shoot-Out.

quickInfo.name: Qualify Shoot-Out
quickInfo.summary: Complete C-I-T-Y and S-L-I-C-K-E-R, or all four $ rollovers.

quickInfo.name: Play Uptown
quickInfo.summary: Hit Uptown targets 1, 2, and 3 in order before time expires.

quickInfo.name: Raise the Award
quickInfo.summary: Repeat the ordered Uptown sequence to advance the lit $ value.

steps.text: Complete C-I-T-Y and S-L-I-C-K-E-R, or collect all four $ rollovers, to qualify Shoot-Out in Uptown.
Shoot the qualified top saucer to capture the ball and bring a second ball into play for Shoot-Out.
During the timed Shoot-Out, hit Uptown targets 1, 2, and 3 in order.
Complete the ordered targets to score the lit $ value; repeat the sequence to advance through the available awards.

alternatives.title: Use the $ rollovers
alternatives.when: Use this when the letter targets are scattered or the upper feed is already controlled.

steps.text: Collect all four $ rollovers instead of finishing both letter words.
Read the top-saucer qualifier before committing to the capture shot.
Finish Uptown 1, 2, and 3 within its short timer to collect the currently lit award.
Complete C-I-T-Y and S-L-I-C-K-E-R or the four $ rollovers again, then repeat the ordered target sequence for the next $ value.

machineSetup: Confirm Shoot-Out timer, Extra Ball and Special conversions, carry of CITY-SLICKER and $ progress, and behavior when a capture is already occupied.
Test every CITY-SLICKER and $ switch, top and middle saucers, two-ball serve and release, Uptown targets 1–3, upper flippers, gates, and trough.

cautions.issue: Uptown targets must be hit in the displayed 1–2–3 order within the short timer.
cautions.response: Do not spray the upper targets; use the upper flippers to follow the lit number.
